newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SWIMMING-TRIPLE OLYMPIC CHAMPION IN "SKINS" EVENT.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-TRIPLE OLYMPIC CHAMPION IN "SKINS" EVENT.

text.p: Irish triple Olympic gold medalist swimmer Michelle Smith will compete in a lucrative one-day "skins" event in Sydney on August 30, swimming officials said on Thursday.
Australians Susie O'Neill and Samantha Riley, American Gary Hall Jnr and Finland's Jani Sievinen have also confirmed they will take part, ruling body Australian Swimming said.

Smith, who won two individual medley events and the 400 metres freestyle at last year's Atlanta Olympics, has agreed to compete in Sydney, six days after the end of the European Championships in Spain.
Under the "skins" rules, swimmers in each event compete in a series of elimination races until just one competitor is left. The 12 events carry a total prizemoney of $A100,000 (US$74,000).
